task.title: Verify Root Map Keys Definition Scope for Keyword Pop-ups
task.shortdesc: Confirm that the root map key definitions are in scope for the topic where the Insert keyword pop-up is expected to resolve.

step.cmd: Open the root DITA map used as the publication entry point and locate the <keydef> elements that define the missing keywords.
Verify each <keydef> has a unique @keys value and that the referenced target (via @href or <topicref>) is valid and reachable.
Open the map that contains the topic where the pop-up is missing and confirm it is included (directly or indirectly) under the same root map.
Check whether the topic is being edited or previewed outside the root map context (for example, opened as a standalone file) and switch to editing via the root map if available.
Confirm the keyword reference in the topic uses the correct key name (case-sensitive) and matches the @keys value defined in the root map.
If multiple root maps exist, confirm you are using the same root map that contains the intended <keydef> set for this deliverable.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
